$comment: Deterministic budgets, enforced in CI (tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs; requests by tests/e2e/kiosk-budget.spec.ts). CPU, memory and frame counts are report-only. Each entry budget is a band: over `warn` prints a warning (a GitHub Actions annotation in CI) and passes; over `fail` is red. Both come from CI's (Linux) measured bytes at Gate 0 (kiosk 296,989, studio 646,714): kiosk warn +15 %, fail +40 %; studio warn +20 %, fail +50 % (G7 change, approved at Gate 0). Raise a band only with a reason in the commit.

packs.$comment: Per built-in pack (src/looks/packs/<id>.ts, its Look id): codeGzipBytes = its lazy JS and CSS chunks (found through the Vite manifest), gzip; assetBytes = the files in src/looks/packs/<id>/assets, bytes on disk; layersPerPage = the layer reasons counted on the heavy kiosk screen with the pack on (tests/e2e/pack-visibility.spec.ts counts them; check-budgets does not). Phase 4 (pack CSS brief): codeGzipBytes and assetBytes are warn lines, set at the bytes measured at Gate 4 (2026-11-22) plus 50 %; over one prints a warning and passes. The fail line is packCeilingBytes for code gzip plus assets, the same cap as a user pack's import (PACK_CEILING_BYTES in src/looks/pack-validate.ts and packs.rs; tests pin all three). layersPerPage stays hard: raise it per pack only with a reason in the commit. A pack with no entry here is a warning that prints its measured bytes (node tools/perf/check-budgets.mjs --packs). Raise any line only with a reason in the commit; a line is not lowered when a pack shrinks.

kioskIdleWarn.$comment: Report-only lines for the heavy kiosk screen at idle (tests/perf/kiosk-idle.perf.ts, case `heavy`, medians): over either prints a warning, never fails. Gate 0: task time 100 ms of main-thread work a second (about 10 % of a core; 68 at Gate 0, 65 at Gate 4) and 24 MB of JS heap (11.8 at Gate 0, 17.7 at Gate 4).
